hybrid.name: Hybrid Form
hybrid.description: A powerful blend of human and beast - enhanced strength and senses

beast.name: Full Beast Form
beast.description: Transform completely into a powerful beast - maximum hunting prowess

dire_wolf.name: Dire Wolf
dire_wolf.description: The ultimate predator form - a massive dire wolf

radiant.name: Radiant Form
radiant.description: Glowing with divine light - enhanced perception and presence

angelic.name: True Angelic Form
angelic.description: Manifest divine wings and celestial power - awe-inspiring presence

catfolk_human.name: Human Form
catfolk_human.description: Fully human appearance - agile and graceful with feline reflexes

kemonomimi.name: Kemonomimi Form
kemonomimi.description: Cat ears and tail - graceful and irresistibly charismatic

full_cat.name: Full Cat Form
full_cat.description: Transform into an adorable cat - everyone who sees you is charmed

unicorn_human.name: Human Form
unicorn_human.description: Human appearance with an ethereal, magical presence

unicorn_form.name: Unicorn Form
unicorn_form.description: Manifest your true unicorn form - a majestic horned equine of pure magic

magus_mortal.name: Mortal Guise
magus_mortal.description: A humble mortal form - your godlike power hidden beneath an unassuming shell

magus_ascended.name: Ascended Magus
magus_ascended.description: Reveal your true arcane nature - reality bends to your will, magic flows through your veins

demigod_form.name: Demigod Incarnate
demigod_form.description: UNLEASH YOUR TRUE DIVINE POWER - The cosmos trembles, reality reshapes itself around you, and mere mortals can only watch in awe

natural_weapons.name: Natural Weapons
natural_weapons.description: Claws and fangs deal additional 1d6 damage

pack_tactics.name: Pack Tactics
pack_tactics.description: +1 attack if another pack member is nearby

intimidating.name: Intimidating Presence
intimidating.description: Creatures may flee instead of fighting

regeneration.name: Regeneration
regeneration.description: Heal 1d4 HP per minute in beast form

radiant_light.name: Radiant Light
radiant_light.description: Emit holy light that reveals hidden creatures

divine_sense.name: Divine Sense
divine_sense.description: +3 to detecting evil, undead, and fiends

flight.name: Flight
flight.description: Can fly, gaining advantage on positioning

feline_agility.name: Feline Agility
feline_agility.description: +2 to dodging attacks and acrobatic maneuvers

graceful_movement.name: Graceful Movement
graceful_movement.description: Move silently and land on your feet from any height

feline_charm.name: Feline Charm
feline_charm.description: +2 to persuasion and getting what you want

irresistibly_adorable.name: Irresistibly Adorable
irresistibly_adorable.description: Everyone who sees you is charmed - NPCs give better prices and are more helpful

pure_aura.name: Pure Aura
pure_aura.description: Radiate purity - evil creatures are uncomfortable near you

horn_attack.name: Horn Attack
horn_attack.description: Your horn deals 1d8+3 piercing damage and counts as magical

magical_presence.name: Magical Presence
magical_presence.description: Your presence enhances magical effects and calms wild creatures

healing_touch.name: Healing Touch
healing_touch.description: Touch a creature to heal 2d6 HP once per hour

arcane_insight.name: Arcane Insight
arcane_insight.description: See the threads of magic in all things - automatically detect magical items, illusions, and hidden enchantments

reality_whisper.name: Reality Whisper
reality_whisper.description: The universe shares its secrets with you - gain hints about hidden paths and outcomes

spell_weaver.name: Spell Weaver
spell_weaver.description: All magical effects you create are amplified by 50% - spells hit harder, heal more, last longer

mana_overflow.name: Mana Overflow
mana_overflow.description: Your magical reserves are bottomless - no cooldowns on magical abilities

arcane_shield.name: Arcane Shield
arcane_shield.description: A shimmering barrier of pure magic surrounds you - reduce all incoming damage by 5

divine_intervention.name: Divine Intervention
divine_intervention.description: Once per session, completely negate any attack, trap, or catastrophe - reality itself bends to protect you

reality_warp.name: Reality Warp
reality_warp.description: Reshape the fabric of existence - create objects, change terrain, or alter circumstances at will

cosmic_presence.name: Cosmic Presence
cosmic_presence.description: Your mere presence inspires absolute awe - all creatures must acknowledge your divine nature

immortal_essence.name: Immortal Essence
immortal_essence.description: You cannot truly die - if reduced to 0 HP, reform at full health after 1 minute in a blaze of divine light

transformation_rules.note: Each form has its own cooldown. Transforming back to human is instant.
transformation_rules.silver_vulnerability: While in beast forms, take 2d6 extra damage from silver weapons

celestial.description: Angels, aasimar, and other celestial beings

catfolk.description: Feline shapeshifters - agile, graceful, and charming

unicorn.description: Magical equine beings of purity and grace

magus.description: Masters of the arcane arts - powerful spellcasters touched by ancient magic

demigod.description: A being of near-infinite cosmic power - half mortal, half divine, wholly terrifying

radiant.name: Radiant Form
radiant.description: Glowing with divine light - enhanced perception and presence

angelic.name: True Angelic Form
angelic.description: Manifest divine wings and celestial power - awe-inspiring presence
